items.title: Classification of Finite Simple Groups Formalized in Lean
items.title_zh: Axiom Math 在 Lean 中形式化有限单群分类定理
items.title_en: Axiom Math Formalizes the Classification of Finite Simple Groups in Lean
items.summary: Axiom Math announces a Lean formalization of the Classification of Finite Simple Groups, prompting discussion on foundations, auto-formalization with frontier models, and the future of large-scale collaborative mathematics.

items.title: 🤖 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Argon，物理推理得分 87%  谷歌发布新一代多模态推理模型 Gemini 4 Argon，强化物理理解、代码生成与视觉语义
items.title_zh: 谷歌据称发布 Gemini 4 Argon，具身推理得分达 87%
items.title_en: Google reportedly launches Gemini 4 Argon with 87% embodied reasoning score
items.summary: Google reportedly released Gemini 4 Argon, a multimodal reasoning model with strong physical/embodied reasoning, robotic control capabilities, SDK access, and published pricing.

items.title: triton-lang/triton released v3.9.0
items.title_zh: Triton 3.9.0 发布：新增原子加载/存储，后端与布局全面升级
items.title_en: Triton 3.9.0 Ships Atomic Load/Store, Backend and Layout Upgrades
items.summary: Triton 3.9.0 release notes detail new atomic load/store ops, compiler and backend (NVIDIA/AMD HIP) improvements, Gluon/layout changes, profiling updates, and breaking changes.

items.title: Genie 4
items.title_zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Genie 4 世界模型，首次原生支持音频
items.title_en: Google DeepMind Unveils Genie 4 World Model With Native Audio
items.summary: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4, a next-generation interactive world-simulation model with audio capabilities, prompting HN discussion that questions whether its frame-consistency truly constitutes 'world simulation.'

items.title: Tailscale SSH: Investigation and remediation update
items.title_zh: Tailscale 发布 Tailscale SSH 漏洞调查与修复更新
items.title_en: Tailscale Publishes Investigation and Remediation Update for Tailscale SSH Flaws
items.summary: Tailscale publishes an investigation and remediation update for vulnerabilities in Tailscale SSH, sparking detailed community analysis of its real-world blast radius and criticism of combining VPN and SSH authentication in one layer.

items.title: Python's experimental JIT to be removed
items.title_zh: CPython 实验性 JIT 编译器将被移除
items.title_en: CPython's experimental JIT compiler is being removed
items.summary: CPython's experimental JIT is being removed, prompting community debate about Python performance strategy, free-threading tradeoffs, and alternatives like Cython.

items.title: Papers with Code is now open-source [P]
items.title_zh: Papers with Code 以 Apache 2.0 开源项目形式重获新生
items.title_en: Papers with Code Revived as Apache 2.0 Open-Source Project
items.summary: Papers with Code has been revived as an Apache 2.0 open-source project with a FastAPI/React stack, public API, and MCP server, inviting community contributions.

items.title: 🤖 OpenAI 发布内部前沿模型生成的数学成果合集  OpenAI 发布由内部未公开前沿模型生成的数学成果，GitHub 合集含 722 篇手稿、372 个结
items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布内部前沿模型生成的 722 篇数学手稿
items.title_en: OpenAI Releases 722 Math Manuscripts Generated by Internal Frontier Model
items.summary: OpenAI published a GitHub collection of 722 mathematical manuscripts and 372 result series generated by an internal unreleased frontier model, many formally verified in Lean, reportedly addressing long-standing open problems.
